speaker: john_heminges
text: No clothes this morning. The apparel is tomorrow, and I will not have a crown tried today for the pleasure of seeing it shine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow, then. Today I can be heard without it. The voice is thick. I am not pretending otherwise.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book is the book. Egeon this afternoon, and he opens, and then he waits. I do not need a new speech from you before dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not have one. I open, and I am idle till the end, and the scarf comes off while I am speaking and goes on when I am not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Be heard at the back when you are on. That is the whole of this morning. Tomorrow the boy is in a longer gown, and you are in a chair, and we will spend the clothes then.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot for tomorrow is not on the peg yet. I am not hanging a king up before the call. Eat between, and be back by noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: By noon. And if anyone asks after the other play, the answer is still the old one until John and I have spoken. I am not burying a king before he is on.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then do not. Speak Egeon so the back of the house has him. The tooth is your business until it is mine, which is when I can hear it from the door.
